inceleme_notu:
Duyguların Peşinde ("In Pursuit of Emotions") is an unpublished book of 30 Turkish poems written between 2008 and 2021, mostly in Istanbul, under the pen name Eylül Bitse. Readers reach the poems through seven emotions, the places where they were written (a map) and time (a timeline). Each poem opens with a photograph of its place, with optional ambient sound and recorded readings. It is for readers of Turkish poetry looking for a quiet, ad-free reading experience.

How to use: no setup, login or sample files. Home screen: tap the featured verse, or pick an emotion under "Bugün neyin peşindesin?". Menu (☰, top right): All poems, Map, Time, Poem fortune, About, Search; at the bottom: language (EN), light/dark theme and the "Günün şiiri" daily local notification. On a poem page: "Mısra kartı" creates a shareable image of selected lines; sharing uses the iOS share sheet; the sound button controls ambient sound and optional background music. Recorded readings ("Sesli dinle") exist for three poems, e.g. "Erik ağacının" (24.05.2017, Altunizade).

No account, login, user-generated content, paid content or in-app purchases.

External services: none for the core functionality. All poems, photographs, sounds and music are bundled and work offline; no analytics, advertising, AI, authentication or payment services; no data is collected. Notifications are local. Only the mailing-list sign-up (duygularinpesinde.bumba.tr) and photo-credit source pages (Wikimedia Commons) open in Safari.

Regional differences: none; the interface is in Turkish and English, the poems stay in Turkish.

Third-party material: poems are original works by the author (pen name Eylül Bitse), published with the author's permission, all rights reserved. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons (CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0); ambient recordings from the Netherlands Institute for Sound and Vision via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0); map outlines from OpenStreetMap data (ODbL); background music produced by us. All are credited under About → Photographs and About → Rights.

tr.tanitim: Basılamayan bir şiir kitabı: 2008–2021 arasında vapurlarda, adalarda, sokaklarda yazılmış 30 şiir. Bir duygunun, bir yerin ya da bir tarihin peşine düşün.
tr.aciklama:
Bir şiir kitabı olacaktı, basılamadı. Duyguların Peşinde, Eylül Bitse imzalı 30 şiiri telefonunuza getiriyor: 2008–2021 arasında İstanbul'un vapurlarında, adalarında, sokaklarında; İzmir'de, Paris'te ve Söğüt'te yazılmış şiirler.

Şiirler sayfa sayfa okunmuyor. Okur bir duygunun, bir yerin ya da bir tarihin peşine düşüyor:

• Yedi duygu, yedi renk: aşk, özlem, hüzün, yalnızlık, ayrılık, karanlık, özgürlük. Her duygunun rengi şiirlerin içinden alındı.
• Her şiir yazıldığı yerin fotoğrafıyla açılıyor ve harf harf yazılıyor.
• Harita: şiirlerin yazıldığı yerler, Moda'dan Burgazada'ya.
• Zaman: 13 yılın duygu tayfı, yıl yıl şiirler.
• Şiir falı: niyet tutun, bir şiir çıksın.
• Günün şiiri: isterseniz her sabah bir şiir bildirimi; o gün yazılmış bir şiir varsa o.
• Mısra kartı: sevdiğiniz mısraları şiirin fotoğrafıyla bir görsele dönüştürüp paylaşın.
• Ortam sesleri (deniz, yağmur, vapur…) ve duygunun makamında fon müziği.
• Bazı şiirler sesli okunuyor.

İnternet gerekmez: bütün şiirler, fotoğraflar ve sesler uygulamanın içinde. Üyelik yok, reklam yok, veri toplanmaz.

Şiirlerin tüm hakları saklıdır. Fotoğraflar Wikimedia Commons'tan, fotoğrafçılarının adıyla ve kendi lisanslarıyla kullanılıyor.

en.tanitim: An unpublished book of poems: 30 poems written between 2008 and 2021 on the ferries, islands and streets of Istanbul. Follow an emotion, a place or a date.
en.aciklama:
It was meant to be a book of poems, but it was never published. Duyguların Peşinde (In Pursuit of Emotions) brings 30 poems signed Eylül Bitse to your phone, written between 2008 and 2021 on the ferries, islands and streets of Istanbul, and in İzmir, Paris and Söğüt.

The poems are not read page by page. You follow an emotion, a place or a date:

• Seven emotions, seven colours: love, longing, sorrow, loneliness, parting, darkness and freedom, each colour taken from the poems themselves.
• Every poem opens with a photograph of the place where it was written, and appears letter by letter.
• Map: where the poems were written, from Moda to Burgazada.
• Time: thirteen years as a spectrum of emotions.
• Poem fortune: make a wish and draw a poem.
• Poem of the day: an optional morning notification, or the poem written on that very day.
• Verse card: turn your favourite lines into an image with the poem's photograph and share it.
• Ambient sounds (sea, rain, ferry…) and background music in each emotion's makam.
• Some poems can be listened to, read aloud.

No internet needed: all the poems, photographs and sounds are inside the app. No account, no ads, no data collected.

The poems are in Turkish, the language they were written in; the app's interface is in Turkish and English. All rights to the poems are reserved. The photographs come from Wikimedia Commons and are used under their own licences, credited to their photographers.
